message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of the Absolute Zero Reasoner’s propose-and-solve training loop.","description":"A process diagram shows an Absolute Zero Reasoner on the left interacting through self-play with a central box of three task types: abduction, deduction, and induction. A red PROPOSE path leads to Python-assisted Construct & Estimate, which connects to the task types and sends a dashed reward signal to Learnability Reward. A blue SOLVE path leads to Python-assisted Verify, which sends a dashed signal to Accuracy Reward. Both reward boxes feed into Joint Update, which updates the reasoner. The legend distinguishes solid model input/output arrows from dashed model reward arrows and defines P, I, and O as program, input, and output.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
